Filter by arch if it has arch-specific and universal binaries

filter_by_arch.Rd

Some builds can have arch-specific and universal binaries. This function filters specifically for data observed in R Universe, which could change in the future.

  • mac universal binaries: _jobs_arch == 'arm64' & !is.na(_binaries_arch)

  • linux universal binaries: _jobs_arch == 'x86_64' & !is.na(_binaries_arch)

Usage

filter_by_arch(df, os, arch = NA)

Arguments

df

data.frame from get_jobs()

os

character

arch

character

Value

data.frame

Examples

df <- get_jobs("bioc", "devel", "4.6.0", "3.23", "macosx", "arm64")
#> Error in get_jobs("bioc", "devel", "4.6.0", "3.23", "macosx", "arm64"): unused arguments ("macosx", "arm64")
filter_by_arch(df, "macosx", "arm64")
